name: WArP
summary: WArP was an early direct liquid-argon WIMP-search programme. Its small dual-phase prototype investigated ionization/scintillation discrimination and argon-39 backgrounds.
detection_principle: The detector records initial liquid-argon scintillation and proportional scintillation after electron extraction into gas. Pulse timing also discriminates nuclear recoils.

results.summary: Measured 39Ar activity in natural argon, providing experimental input for liquid-argon dark-matter background control.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
